reason: The Step 2C validator required a retained requalification signal to use the current A2 revision ID, which conflicted with immutable signal history across later A2 revisions.
clarification: a2_record_revision_id identifies the revision in which a signal or return was created. It remains immutable. A later A2 revision may retain the artifact and advance only its approved lifecycle fields. New signals and returns must identify the current creation revision.
schema_compatibility: The Step 2C JSON Schemas remain version 0.1.0 because their field shapes do not change. The clarification changes cross-field lifecycle validation only.
